project: Hypothetical example: work-order bootstrap in one staging environment

tasks.title: Verify scope, existing resources and bootstrap access
produces: Observed inventory with sources and gaps
Inputs for account, region, network, repo, runner, identity and budget
acceptance: Confirm or reject each reuse assumption without creating resources
Identify the real OIDC format and the backend locking mechanism
Record any absence as a blocker of the dependent actions, preserving independent authoring

tasks.title: Draft minimal contracts for the flow, the data and the runtime
produces: Versioned drafts of API, DATA and RUNTIME
Examples and fakes for opening, listing, updating and completing an order with a synthetic attachment
acceptance: Declare assumptions, exclusions, roles and expected errors
Define serving the web from the same artifact as the API, configuration, health/readiness, identity and secret refs
Do not present drafts as approved or implemented

tasks.title: Review contracts and decide on releasing the consumers
produces: Decision recorded per contract with review and open items
Conditions for a future snapshot with stable contracts
acceptance: Resolve differences between discovery and drafts before releasing consumers
Obtain acceptance from the contract owners and record evidence of the decision
Keep contracts draft in the initial snapshot; the forecast conditionally assumes this task is complete

tasks.title: Prepare, in one PR, the platform base that is independent of the application
produces: IaC composition for registry, private bucket, DB, identities and logs
Typed inputs and outputs, static validation and cost assumption
acceptance: Do not depend on an application image or backend code
Use network, backend, runner and bootstrap identity only if verified
Preserve parametric configuration and review conformance to DATA/RUNTIME before the merge

tasks.title: Review the platform base PR
produces: Review opinion on diff, interfaces, IAM, data, cost and recovery
acceptance: A reviewer other than the authoring owner examines the IaC diff and the real plan of the same candidate revision
Check that inventory, inputs, effects, cost and recovery match the published plan; require updated evidence if the content changes
Examine concrete risks and relevant tests, without requiring the application or the backend to be ready

tasks.title: Integrate the base PR according to the applicable checks
produces: Integrated commit of the foundation composition
acceptance: Merge identified by SHA and the repository's real checks
Run only within the authorized scope, preserving existing rules

tasks.title: Generate the real plan of the base in the verified environment
produces: Real plan of the authoring branch, identified by commit, IaC content, lockfiles and inputs
Summary of creations, estimated cost and effects for the review of PR-01
acceptance: Confirm account, region, backend and identity before the real plan of the candidate branch
Reconcile the resource inventory with the plan diff; republish the plan and the map if creations, changes or dependencies that were not forecast appear
Do not publish sensitive values or use a state change to work around a divergence

tasks.title: Apply the base using the already verified bootstrap identity
produces: Base resources created in staging and outputs observed
acceptance: Confirm that the integrated commit, IaC content, lockfiles, inputs and target match the reviewed plan immediately before the apply
If content or relevant state changed, recompute the plan, reconcile and republish the inventory and review only the material differences; do not require redundant approval of an unchanged plan
Check existing authorization and budget; a real absence blocks this apply
Do not wait for API, web, runtime PR or image to create registry, DB, bucket and identities

tasks.title: Prove the readiness of the base before the runtime
produces: Evidence of registry, DB, private bucket, roles and logs
Outputs published without plaintext secrets
acceptance: Check existence, configuration, network reach and allowed/denied permissions
Verify the DB is available without claiming the application schema is installed
Record the base as ready regardless of when coding ends

tasks.title: Implement API, migration and restricted credential bootstrap
produces: Local API with dependency fakes
Additive migration and idempotent routine for the restricted DB user
Contract and behavior tests
acceptance: Implement only orders, the planned roles and the synthetic attachments of the slice
Validate IdP tokens and prevent access outside the role
Do not use the DB administrative credential in the normal runtime

tasks.title: Implement the web flow against the contract and fakes
produces: Navigable web with login through the existing IdP and the orders flow
Static build to be served in the API artifact
acceptance: Cover loading, error, empty and validation states
Use compatible fakes without requiring applied infrastructure
Keep the web dependencies and lockfile within its area

tasks.title: Prepare CI and delivery by digest in one capability PR
produces: CI and delivery workflows
Build of the single artifact with web and API
Declared environment and identity configuration
acceptance: Separate credential-free validation from privileged jobs
Provide for an identity smoke test without requiring an integrated app
Prepare promotion by digest and migration through the verified private runner

tasks.title: Prepare acceptance scenarios and fixtures independent of the backend
produces: Scenarios for the flow, denied access and attachment behavior
Synthetic fixtures and evidence criteria
acceptance: Relate scenarios to the contract and to the risks of the slice
Do not treat test preparation as a successful run

tasks.title: Review the scenarios written by the delivery owner
produces: Independent review of scenarios and fixtures
acceptance: Check expected results and the absence of a circular dependency with the implementation
Do not approve a scenario only because it repeats the code

tasks.title: Prepare the runtime composition without waiting for the backend to be ready
produces: IaC for task definition, service, target group, listener rule and alarms
Inputs for digest, secrets and foundation outputs
acceptance: Validate authoring with typed inputs and identified placeholders
Separate the real plan/apply, which depend on the image and the prepared DB
Do not create Kubernetes, a new ALB or a new VPC

tasks.title: Review the CI/CD PR and the identity limits
produces: Review opinion on workflows, permissions, build and promotion
acceptance: Check immutable references and the handling of untrusted inputs
Check that the pipeline does not require the new role to run the first bootstrap

tasks.title: Integrate workflows and the declared delivery configuration
produces: Integrated commit of the CI/CD PR
acceptance: Preserve the checks and authorization already established
Record the integrated SHA without claiming the workflow ran

tasks.title: Activate the environment and configure the use of the new identity
produces: Staging environment and workflows configured in the existing repository
acceptance: Reconcile declared configuration and references to secrets without exposing values
Use the delivery role created by the foundation, without a permanent credential in a file
Record the workflow revision materialized by the merge and its activation

tasks.title: Run a CI and identity smoke test without deploying
produces: Verifiable validation and identity run
Evidence of correct permissions and targets
acceptance: Observe the real workflow and the restricted federated identity
Keep this evidence separate from the application build and deploy, still pending

tasks.title: Consolidate the flow into one reviewable diff before the PR review
produces: Consolidated branch/commit of API, web, migration and tests for PR-02
Integrated diff and results of the local tests relevant to the set
acceptance: Consolidate identified commits from the independent worktrees and resolve conflicts before requesting review
Confirm the set's contracts, lockfiles and migrations and run the relevant local tests
Keep a single PR for the flow; do not claim real integration in staging from these local tests

tasks.title: Review the flow PR with API, web, migration and tests
produces: Integrated review opinion on the first product capability
acceptance: Review the consolidated diff and commit in APP-ASSEMBLE, with evidence of the set's local tests
Review API and web code with an owner other than the authors
Use the independent review of the reviewer's own QA files
Validate contract, relevant tests and migration plan

tasks.title: Integrate the first product capability
produces: Integrated commit of the work-order flow
acceptance: Tie the merge to the checks and reviews actually completed
Do not equate a merge with a deployed application

tasks.title: Build and publish the release candidate by digest
produces: OCI image containing API and web
Digest, commit, dependency inventory and build results
acceptance: Publish to the ECR created by the foundation using a restricted identity
Use identified sources and dependencies and do not include secrets

tasks.title: Check the identity and minimal behavior of the artifact
produces: Verified digest and local smoke test of the published artifact
acceptance: Check the link between the digest and the tested commit
Verify port, health, web assets and the absence of embedded sensitive configuration

tasks.title: Review the runtime PR and its integration with the base
produces: Review opinion on runtime, exposure, secret refs and alarms
acceptance: Check stable inputs and a compatible network
Require a real digest only in the plan and apply, without blocking authoring

tasks.title: Integrate the reviewed runtime composition
produces: Integrated commit of the runtime
acceptance: Record SHA and completed checks
Keep foundation and runtime in separate roots/states

tasks.title: Generate the runtime plan with real outputs and digest
produces: Real plan of the service activation with a verified digest
acceptance: Check replacements, exposure and capacity of one staging replica
Record the dependency on the schema verification before the apply

tasks.title: Apply the migration and initialize the restricted DB identity
produces: Orders schema and application user
Initial version of the application secret
acceptance: Run on the verified private runner using an identified artifact
Generate and store the restricted credential without printing the value or including it in state
Make the routine idempotent and preserve semantics on resume

tasks.title: Verify integrity and privilege of the prepared schema
produces: Evidence of migration, restricted user and retrievable secret
acceptance: Validate positive and negative permissions with synthetic data
Check the integrity and version of the migration before the runtime

tasks.title: Activate the service after the image and schema are verified
produces: Fargate service, routing and alarms applied
acceptance: Apply the plan that matches the authorized digest, commit and environment
Preserve the real lock of the runtime state
Record one staging replica without claiming high availability

tasks.title: Verify the deployment and its operational signals
produces: Evidence of deployed digest, readiness, routing, logs and alarms
acceptance: Check the real resource and smoke traffic through the planned ingress
Verify secret refs and log arrival without leakage
Record the absence of data in the alarms without calling it a completed alert test

tasks.title: Run the complete flow in staging with real implementations
produces: Results of opening, listing, updating, completing and attachments
Evidence of allowed/denied access and data integration
acceptance: Run scenarios against the real service and IdP of the authorized staging
Use only synthetic data and identified test objects
Verify behavior and the corresponding operational evidence

tasks.title: Consolidate staging readiness, limits and recovery
produces: Readiness report for the slice and resume runbook
Explicit list of what was not run or validated
acceptance: Reference real commits, digests, runs and verifications
Distinguish the test environment from production
Do not turn the absence of an observed failure into a guarantee of availability or security
